description: Frozen Landing Zone design-area taxonomy. Domain and criterion iteration must come from this registry.

design_areas.name: Tenant, billing & organization construct
workshop_themes: Where is the authoritative cloud organization, and who owns it?
Are production workloads forbidden from the management/payer plane?
Does billing, contract and technical ownership describe the same estate?

design_areas.name: Identity & access
workshop_themes: How does a human get access, and how is it taken away?
How is privileged access made eligible, time-bound and logged?
How do workloads authenticate without long-lived secrets?

design_areas.name: Resource organization
workshop_themes: Does the hierarchy encode policy, or is it a filing cabinet?
Where does the platform landing zone end and an application landing zone begin?
How is a new subscription, account or project born?

design_areas.name: Network topology & connectivity
workshop_themes: Where is the hub, and what is forced through it?
Who owns hybrid connectivity, DNS and inspection?
Is private-by-default a control, or a preference?

design_areas.name: Security baseline
workshop_themes: What is prevented by the platform, versus detected after the fact?
Where do logs, detections and keys live — and who operates them?
Are secrets and encryption a control, or a developer preference?

design_areas.name: Management & observability
workshop_themes: Where do activity, resource and diagnostic logs actually land?
Can the platform list every subscription, account or project this week?
If the platform burned down, what would restore it?

design_areas.name: Governance & policy
workshop_themes: What does the platform actually deny, versus what it merely audits?
How is an exemption born, lived, and killed?
Can compliance evidence be exported, or only screenshot?

design_areas.name: Platform automation & DevOps
workshop_themes: Is the landing zone born from code, or from a portal?
How does drift get detected, and who is allowed to hotfix the foundation?
Can an application team request a landing zone without a six-week ticket?
